lines.text: [excited] Need serious current from a flat, light pack? Meet LiPo pouch cells!
From about fourteen hundred to twenty-two thousand milliamp-hours per cell.
The big ones? Up to three hundred twenty amps continuous. Per cell!
Want more energy? High-voltage LiPo charges all the way to four point three five volts.
Got your own pouch cell? Just enter its data in the Battery Design Studio.
[excited] Drone, robot, or racer... what would YOU build? Tell us in the comments!
